basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 28-year-old software developer who recently moved to Budapest for work. I grew up in a small town and have always been fascinated by technology and urban life. I love exploring new hobbies, and right now I'm really into outdoor roller skating, even though I'm just starting out. I also enjoy tinkering with mechanics and have spent countless hours on Scrap Mechanic. Besides that, I'm exploring biohacking to optimize my health and productivity. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently, I'm single and enjoying the new adventure of living in a vibrant city.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for the past 5 years. My interest in mechanics is self-taught, fueled by curiosity and countless hours spent on simulation games like Scrap Mechanic. I also dabble in biohacking, learning from online resources and experimenting with different techniques to improve personal health and efficiency.
